facts.text: Deborah organized a yoga event that included yoga sessions, food stalls, and live music.

evidence.quote: I've been focusing on teaching yoga and spending time with the community. Organizing a yoga event last month was really cool.
I reached out to different nearby businesses and places to make it happen. We had yoga, food stalls, and even some live music - it was amazing!

facts.text: Deborah suggests prioritizing and managing time effectively to maintain balance between hobbies and studies.

evidence.quote: As for balancing hobbies and studies, I find it helpful to prioritize and manage my time effectively. Making a schedule and setting aside specific time for studying and pursuing hobbies can go a long way in maintaining balance.

facts.text: Jolene purchased a console for her partner on the 17th of August, 2023, and he was able to play it.

evidence.quote: I bought a console for my partner as a gift on the 17th and it's so much fun, he even managed to play it.

facts.text: Jolene asked Deborah about the rewards of organizing the yoga event and sought tips for balancing hobbies and studies.

evidence.quote: Was it rewarding seeing everyone come together? Can you tell me more about how you put it together? Also, any tips for maintaining a balance between hobbies and studies?
